content.user_title: Read Linear Issues from the Command Line
content.value_statement: Finding relevant Linear issues manually can slow project reviews. This skill provides read-only commands for filtered lists and individual issue details.
actual_capabilities: Lists Linear issues through a documented read-only command.
Filters issue lists by team, project, assignee, or status.
Limits list results with a configurable maximum.
Retrieves one issue by issue identifier or UUID.
Offers human-readable and JSON output modes.
Resolves team, user, and label names without case sensitivity.
limitations: Requires Bun and a valid LINEAR_API_KEY.
Supports reading issues only and does not create or update them.
Referenced implementation files are absent from the audited package.
Available fields and permissions depend on the connected Linear account.

use_cases.title: Review assigned work
use_cases.description: List current issues for one assignee and status before a daily planning session.

use_cases.title: Monitor project progress
use_cases.description: Retrieve a limited issue list for one project to support delivery reviews.

use_cases.title: Inspect support issues
use_cases.description: Open a specific issue by identifier to review its available details.

prompt_templates.title: List recent team issues

prompt_templates.scenario: Start with a simple filtered issue list.

prompt_templates.title: Find assigned active work
prompt_templates.prompt: List Linear issues assigned to [name] with status [status].

prompt_templates.title: Inspect one issue
prompt_templates.prompt: Get Linear issue [issue identifier] and show the command output without reformatting it.
prompt_templates.scenario: Retrieve the available details for a known issue.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare filtered analysis
prompt_templates.prompt: List issues for project [project] as JSON, then summarize status distribution and identify blocked work.
prompt_templates.scenario: Request structured output and an explicit follow-up analysis.

output_examples.output: A terminal table showing up to 10 matching issues with the fields provided by the command.
The available details for ENG-123 are displayed directly in the terminal.

output_examples.input: Summarize active issues assigned to Alex.
output: The command lists matching active issues.
A requested summary groups the visible results by status and highlights notable work.

best_practices: Use the narrowest team, project, assignee, and status filters needed.
Set a reasonable result limit before requesting broad issue lists.
Request analysis explicitly when you need more than direct command output.
anti_patterns: Do not include the LINEAR_API_KEY value in prompts or command output.
Do not request issue creation or updates from this read-only skill.
Do not assume referenced commands work until the missing implementation files are installed.

faq.question: What does this skill read?
faq.answer: It documents commands for listing Linear issues and retrieving one issue by identifier or UUID.

faq.question: Can it modify Linear issues?
faq.answer: No. The documented operations are read-only.

faq.question: Which credentials are required?
faq.answer: It requires LINEAR_API_KEY in the environment or a project environment file.

faq.question: Which filters are available?
faq.answer: The list command documents team, project, assignee, status, and result limit options.

faq.question: Can it return structured output?
faq.answer: Yes. Both documented commands provide a JSON output option.

faq.question: Is the implementation included?
faq.answer: No. The audited package contains documentation and metadata, but the referenced command implementations are absent.
